## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the introductory companion to [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ's *[Wǔ jiào yí 五教儀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0142)* (X1024) — the *kāi méng* "introductory manual" providing accessible entry to the larger 6-fascicle parent work. The pair (X1024 + X1025) constitutes Xùfǎ's primary textual apparatus for late-imperial Huáyán doctrinal teaching.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1660 – 1715) reflects [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ's mature scholarly activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1025) collection.
